**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 16:36
- [EVENT] User is planning to run a half-marathon in three months.
- [PREFERENCE] User wants tips on how to increase mileage safely.
- [EVENT] User recently got a new pair of running shoes from the Nike outlet store at the mall.
- [FACT] User can feel the difference in terms of cushioning and support with the new shoes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on the upcoming half-marathon and the new shoes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for increasing mileage safely, including:
  1. Gradual progression of no more than 10% weekly mileage increase.
  2. Listening to the body's signals and taking rest days if needed.
  3. Building up base mileage with 3-4 shorter runs and one longer run weekly.
  4. Incorporating walk breaks if new to running or significantly increasing mileage.
  5. Strengthening core and glutes with exercises 2-3 times a week.
  6. Incorporating rest and recovery, including 1-2 rest days and prioritizing stretching.
  7. Hydrating and fueling properly with a balanced diet and electrolytes.
  8. Getting enough sleep (7-9 hours per night).
  9. Mixing up routes and terrain to reduce injury risk.
  10. Seeking professional guidance if unsure about increasing mileage safely.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to break in the new shoes gradually by wearing them for shorter runs.
